title: Google Cloud Targets 960K Nvidia GPUs With A5X Instance Launch

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Vera Rubin hardware has reached general availability for customers on the cloud platforms operated by Google. This rollout introduces A5X AI instances to the ecosystem, which will serve as the foundation for plans to expand the provider's total compute capacity to as many as 960,000 Nvidia GPUs.

The expansion occurs as Google continues to develop and operate one of the most advanced internal custom TPU programs in the industry. Despite these in-house efforts, the company is aggressively increasing its third-party GPU footprint to meet AI processing demand.
